Game Overview

At its heart, Strange Packages is a adventure game about unravel the sinister mystery of constant deliveries in "Strange Packages." Navigate through haunting transformations as familiar spaces become otherworldly labyrinths. With every knock, bizarre items blur friend from foe, while walls gain unblinking eyes and toys spring to life. Discover if the deliverer is a savior or a threat.
